cv.title: Social media manager

cl.p1: Our most watched video at the lemonade company has 1.2 million views and cost £12: lemons, a tripod and a colleague from the bottling line who explains things well. Since then I know that good ideas matter more than big budgets.
cl.p2: For three years I have run the channels of a single brand and grown them from 9,000 to 85,000 followers. At your agency I would like to work for several clients, with colleagues I can learn from.
cl.p3: I am happy to send you a selection of my work beforehand.
